label: S5_AjBonos
code_lines: ﻿/*CIERRE 2021: SE REALIZA AJUSTE DE BONOS CONSIDERANDO BONOS DE CORTO Y LARGO PLAZO, PARA NO ALTERAR TANTO LAS EMISIONES DE LOS SECTORES POR TENENCIAS NEGATIVAS
SI LA SUMA DE AMBOS PLAZOS EN NEGATIVA, SE IMPUTA EMIION DE BONOS EN EL LP*/
/*selecciona bonos de lp/ saldo inicial y final ACTIVO POR CONTRAPARTIDA*/
(CASE WHEN T2.C_SI_SCN='S.124' THEN 'S.123' ELSE T2.C_SI_SCN END) AS C_SI,
(CASE WHEN T3.C_SI_SCN ='S.124' THEN 'S.123' ELSE T3.C_SI_SCN  END) AS C_SI_CAGENTE,
where T1.AÑO>2002 AND T1.C_CUENTA IN ('Bce Final','Bce Inicio') AND T1.C_SCN IN ('AF.32','AF.31') AND T1.C_ENTRADA='D' AND T3.C_SI_SCN NOT IN ('S.2')
GROUP BY T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM,CALCULATED C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN,T1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA, CALCULATED C_SI,CALCULATED C_SI_CAGENTE;
/*selecciona bonos de lp con saldo inicial y final negativos*/
WHERE T1.C_SI_CAGENTE<>'S.2' AND T1.DATO<0 AND T1.DATO<-0.01;QUIT;
/*selecciona bonos de lp/ saldo inicial y final PASIVO TOTAL*/
(CASE WHEN T2.C_SI_SCN='S.124' THEN 'S.123' ELSE T2.C_SI_SCN END) AS C_SI,
where T1.AÑO>2002 AND T1.C_CUENTA IN ('Bce Final','Bce Inicio') AND T1.C_SCN IN ('AF.32','AF.31') AND T1.C_ENTRADA='H'
GROUP BY T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM,CALCULATED C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN,T1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA, CALCULATED C_SI;
/*calcula diferencial de precio para eliminar negativos*/
PROC SQL;/*TIENE FILTRADO EL AÑO 2017...IR CAMBIANDO A TRIM DE COYUNTURA*/
T1.C_SI_CAGENTE, T1.C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA,T1.DATO*-1 AS NEG, T2.DATO AS TOTAL, (T1.DATO/T2.DATO) AS DELTA_PRECIO
WHERE (T1.AÑO= T2.AÑO AND T1.TRIM=T2.TRIM AND T1.C_SI_CAGENTE=T2.C_SI AND T1.C_CUENTA=T2.C_CUENTA) /*AND T1.AÑO=&ANIO AND T1.TRIM=&TRIM*/;
/*imputa saldo negativo en emisiones/balance final e inicial*/
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA,T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM,T2.C_SI AS SECTOR,'53' AS C_CAGENTE,T1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN AS C_SCN,
'Valores distintos de acciones a largo plazo' AS N_SCN, T1.C_CUENTA, 'H' AS C_ENTRADA,NEG as DATO, 'AB' AS FUENTE,'1000' AS PROC
/*imputa saldo negativo en tenencias/balance final e inicial*/
SELECT 'P' AS MONEDA,T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM,T2.C_SI AS SECTOR,LEFT(PUT(T3.C_SI,NUMX5.)) AS C_CAGENTE,T1.C_INSTRUMENTO_SCN AS C_SCN,
'Valores distintos de acciones a largo plazo' AS N_SCN, T1.C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA,NEG as DATO, 'AB' AS FUENTE,'1001' AS PROC
SELECT T1.MONEDA,T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR,T1.C_CAGENTE,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN, 'Rec Precio' AS C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_CUENTA='Bce Inicio' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) as DATO, 'AB' AS FUENTE,'1002' AS PROC
GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR,T1.C_CAGENTE,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN, CALCULATED C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA, CALCULATED FUENTE, CALCULATED PROC;QUIT;
SELECT T1.MONEDA,T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR,T1.C_CAGENTE,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN, 'Rec Precio' AS C_CUENTA, T1.C_ENTRADA,
SUM(CASE WHEN T1.C_CUENTA='Bce Inicio' THEN T1.DATO*-1 ELSE T1.DATO END) as DATO, 'AB' AS FUENTE,'1003' AS PROC
GROUP BY T1.MONEDA,T1.AÑO, T1.TRIM,T1.SECTOR,T1.C_CAGENTE,T1.C_SCN,T1.N_SCN, CALCULATED C_CUENTA,T1.C_ENTRADA, CALCULATED FUENTE, CALCULATED PROC;QUIT;
